items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: No, not with Bessie. No, I think that was [Clarence P. Johnson] (Fred Longshaw - ed.)

ctx.x: So that was when I was about 11 years old, you know. And he's been my idol every since. Ever since I first heard him play behind Bessie Smith. And I think Earl Hines was playing piano.
No, not with Bessie. No, I think that was [Clarence P. Johnson] (Fred Longshaw - ed.)
Was it? Didn't he make some with Bessie Smith?
